programme.desc: Princess Cleopatra becomes Egypt's Queen and has an out-of-wedlock son with the son-less Roman ruler Julius Caesar. Through two romances, she strives to protect Egypt from the Romans, and make her son the heir to Caesar's Roman Empire.

programme.title: Povratak u Plavu lagunu, film
programme.desc: Spas su potražili na malom, izoliranom rajskom otočiću usred oceana. Iako im se činilo da je život savršen, jednoga dana sve se počinje mijenjati... Brod kojim su putovale udovica Sarah Hargrave i njezina jednogodišnja kćer Lili zahvaća smrtonosna bolest od koje umiru roditelji dvogodišnjeg Richarda. Sarah je s Lili i Richardom prebačena na mali brodić nadajući se spasu od kolere. Morske struje odnijele su ih do neciviliziranog tropskog otočića gdje Sarah svu pažnju posvećuje odgoju i edukaciji dvoje malene djece. Oni odrastaju zdravo i sretno u skladu s prirodom i nisu ni svjesni tvorevinama modernog društva. Prije no što su dosegli zrelost, Sarah umire od upale pluća. Otkrivajući zajedno sve tajne odrastanja i zrelosti, Lili i Richard iskreno su se zaljubili. Njihovom idiličnom življenju došao je kraj dolaskom broda koji ih je prisilio da se po prvi put upoznaju sa svim tekovinama civilizacije. Williama A. Graham snimio je odličan, mnogi će reći i suoperiorniji film od "Plave lagune". Prekrasni prizori prirode, odlični glumci i zanimljiva radnja s romantičnim i akcijskim elementima čini formulu koja ne može obmanuti. Prekrasana Milla Jovovich ("Peti element", "Resident Evil: Apocalypse") briljira, a za njom ne zaostaje ni sjajni Brian Krause kojem je ta uloga otvorila vrata za dokazivanje u brojnim kazališnim ostvarenjima, TV serijama i filmovima.

programme.title: Igra pobjednika, film
programme.desc: Dobitnici Oscara, scenaristi Steven Zaillian (Schindlerova lista) i Aaron Sorkin (Društvena mreža) jedni su od autora scenarija filma „Igra pobjednika“ kojeg je režirao Bennett Miller (nominiran za nagradu Oscar za režiju filma „Capote“). Glavni lik priče je Billy Beane, generalni menadžer bejzbolskog kluba Oakland Athletics koji će isti pokušati obnoviti na potpuno novi, moderniziraniji način. U filmu su glavne uloge ostvarili Brad Pitt, Robin Wright, Jonah Hill i Phillip Seymour Hoffman.

programme.title: Fântomas protiv Scotland Yarda, film
programme.desc: U trećem i posljednjem nastavku trilogije Fantômas nameće porez bogatašima prijeteći da će ubiti one koji to ne prihvate. Novinara Fandora i komesara Juvea u Škotsku poziva Lord McRashley. Lord McRashley, jedna od potencijalnih Fantômasovih žrtava, svoj dvorac koristi za postavljanje zamke napasti zvanoj Fantômas... "Fantomas" je 1964. bio odgovor Francuske na fenomen Jamesa Bonda koji je pomeo svijet u to doba. Fantômas je postao silno uspješan u Europi, Sovjetskom Savezu i Japanu. Uspio je i u SAD-u gdje dan-danas postoje web-stranice obožavatelja. Opći ton filmova lakši je od originalnih romana Fantômas koje su napisali Pierre Souvestre i Marcel Allain.

programme.title: Dobro došli u džunglu, film
programme.desc: U oduvijek gruboj i opasnoj urbanoj džungli Los Angelesa, postoje ljudi kao Beck (The Rock) čovjek koji se koristi svime što mu je potrebno da pronađe ono za što je plaćen. Zalog, zakašnjelo plaćanje ili prsten Super Bowla od braniča s kockarskim dugovima - Beck ne pravi razliku i samo se oslanja na vlastite snage, sa svojim stavom kojim kao da govori idemo to riješiti što prije" i svojom razornom fizičkom smjelosti da dovrši posao. Za njega je to jednostavan svijet s više izbora: (A) Beckov način, (B) Beckov način putem sile, (C) nema. Beck ne traži nevolje niti ih voli nekome stvarati. Nažalost, nevolja je u tome što je unajmljen za čišćenje, a da bi se sve to ostavio iza sebe mora počistiti još jedan nered. A taj samo postaje sve zamršeniji, kao Amazonska džungla u koju je poslan u In The Rundown. U središtu događanja je pametnjaković Travis (Seann William Scott), preprodavač čiji je otac zaposlio Becka da ga vrati s njegove avanture u Brazilu. Travis se pokaže većim zalogajem nego što je Beck očekivao, ne samo zbog svog brzog jezika i upornog suprotstavljanja odlasku, nego i zbog nekih drugih komplikacija koje dolaze zajedno s njim: Mariana (Rosario Dawson), lokalna djevojka koja skriva odgovore na neke misterije džungle, i Hatcher (Christopher Walken), despot koji je džunglu i njene stanovnike pretvorio u svoje carstvo u kojem stvara bogatstvo i traži zlato.

programme.title: Legenda o Zorrou, film
programme.desc: Nekoliko godina nakon prethodne pustolovine Alejandro (Antonio Banderas) i Elena (Catherine Zeta-Jones) žive u braku i imaju desetogodišnjega sina Joaquina (Adrian Alonso). Iako se Alejandro i dalje koristi maskom Zorroa kako bi štitio siromašne i nemoćne od pohlepe njihovih gospodara, rastrgan je između dužnosti i želje za normalnim životom. Ponovno ga čeka borba kada planove da Kalifornija postane 31. država SAD-a ugrozi zločinačka urota skupine moćnih veleposjednika. U hrabrom pokušaju da onemogući njihove planove, Zorro srlja u opasnost koja prijeti njegovu životu i sigurnosti njegove obitelji.

programme.title: Venom, film
programme.desc: Evolucijska priča Marvelova zagonetnog, složenog i opakog lika - Venoma! Eddie Brock (Tom Hardy) je slomljen čovjek koji je izgubio sve, uključujući posao i zaručnicu. Baš kad mu život padne na najniže grane, on postaje domaćin izvanzemaljskom simbiotu, što rezultira čudesnim supermoćima preobrazivši ga u Venoma. Hoće li te moći dostajati tom novom ubojitom zaštitniku da pobijedi velike sile zla, a pogotovo protiv mnogo jačeg i bolje naoružanog suparničkog simbiota, Riota?

programme.desc: Anđeli Natalie (Cameron Diaz), Dylan i (Drew Barrymore) Alex (Lucy Liu) su unajmljene da pronađu set ukradenih titanskih prstena koji će stavljeni zajedno u poseban stroj prikazati listu svih osoba uključenih u program zaštite svjedoka. Otkriva se da je Dylanino ime nekoć bilo Helen Zass, te da je i sama uključena u program. U nastavku se otkriva da kradljivac pokušava prodati prstene najvećem ponuđivaču u različitim mafijaškim grupama diljem svijeta, a u konačnici i da je bivši "anđeo" Madison Lee (Demi Moore) upletena u zločine.

programme.title: Brzina ubija
programme.desc: There's more than just one creature lurking in this black lagoon. Here, in this bizarre netherworld between river and ocean, evolution has created a variety of freakish assassins, many of whom can strike in the blink of an eye. Witness the fast-paced, deadly action up close and in slow motion as our high-speed cameras capture sharp-shooting archerfish, African fish eagles, mantis shrimp, and other killers at work. Cutting-edge CGI details show just how they use their alien jaws, spear-like arms, and color-changing skin as weapons of underwater war.

programme.title: Plavo carstvo
programme.desc: Believe it or not, many scuba divers want to see great whites up close, and photographers want dramatic shots. But how do you get the sharks to where you want them? For decades, it's been done by baiting, or chumming - attracting sharks with food. This practice is being questioned and banned in many countries because of a dramatic increase in shark attacks.

programme.title: Životinjska ambasada
programme.desc: Rafa, the ‘Birdman of Loro Parque’, proudly leads the Foundation’s ornithological work, surrounded daily by parrots, puffins, and penguins. Meanwhile, Inaki faces a challenge: training Sue-Anne the anteater. Armed with vanilla yoghurt and patience, he’s hoping charm wins over stubbornness. Will she cooperate or snub his efforts?

programme.title: Glazbeni putnik
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don’t have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Putovanja kroz povijest
programme.desc: O Say can you see? We’re in Baltimore, MD. We’ll learn about the Battle of Baltimore at Fort McHenry and the inspiration of the Star Spangled Banner. Then we dig deep into the history of Baltimore’s most famous resident, Edgar Allan Poe. We’ll sift through a huge collection of pop art and collectibles at the Geppi Museum, and learn about cracking codes at the National Cryptology museum.

programme.title: Sile prirode
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature’s heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let’s look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Sile prirode
programme.desc: A snapshot of Seasons, how they work together and keep the globe in balance. Droughts are explored in terms of how we can predict them, proof our lives from them and collect data because of them. Hurricanes are explained, their power revealed and the measures that are used to help us survive their impact. Thunderstorms have a few stages of development that roll out in a particular order.

programme.title: Divlja Australija s Rayem Mearsom
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray explores the Red Centre of the country and shows that the Australian desert is filled with life for those who know where to find water.He arrives in the Red Centre by chopper as he flies over the Uluru monolith or Ayres Rock. For his first stop, he goes to a red kangaroo sanctuary where he cuddles a joey, meets their carer Brolga and gets close to the usually wary adult red kangaroos. He pursues his journey deeper in the desert to meet a local aboriginal Sammy Wilson. They go to a traditional waterhole and chat over a camp fire about Sammy’s ancestral knowledge of the land. Ray spends the night out under the stars before driving more inland to rocky areas where water collects. There Ray comes face to face with a wild kangaroo and rock wallabies. He then follows tracks along a dry river bed that lead him to Australia’s wild dog: a dingo.

programme.title: Pokaži mi gdje živiš
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Putovanja po Indiji
programme.desc: We explore the capital of India. The bustling metropolis is filled with modern skyscrapers that stand side-by-side with hundreds of ancient monuments, making Delhi a physical dichotomy of yesterday and tomorrow. In the old city, we travel by rickshaw through the narrow streets and discover a world that is quickly disappearing. Then it’s on to the tomb of Humayun, whose architectural design inspired one of the Seven Wonders of the World, the great Taj Mahal. We visit 2 mosques that are in the record books: the very first mosque in Delhi and the largest mosque in India. Next we visit the National Gandhi Museum where we view personal items from Gandhi’s life, visit a temple that’s open to all faiths and complete the quickest tour of India, without leaving Delhi.

programme.title: Putovanje iz snova
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! - No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people - from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Svakodnevni elementi
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.desc: It’s one of the world’s most famous train stations. GRAND CENTRAL TERMINAL. We’ll take you on a trip to reveal its many fascinating secrets! And if they are cleaned without water, how do clothes get spotless when they are DRY CLEANED?

programme.title: Oh, to nisam znao!

programme.title: Sile prirode
programme.desc: How are Rainbows formed and what’s their science? We look at the largest Hail ever recorded and explain why it comes in so many shapes and sizes. Global Warming is a big issue and topic, and we give a nutshell insight to its meaning and impact on many levels. Forecasting is key and crucial to living with nature and its weather, as it involves precision technologies and expertise. Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.title: Šašava znanost
programme.desc: Computers: Early examples of computers are the ancient Antikythera machine and the 19th century engines made by Charles Babbage. But Babbages's designs could not be completed as its construction was ahead of its time! The makers of the first electric computer got a $850 fee to complete their work. They did, but WW2 halted progression. That same war sparked the need for a rapid development for strong calculation machines. The computer was invented because astronauts and the military needed huge calculators. You see, it’s hard for a human being to calculate immense figures like ‘how far will this space shuttle be in six days if we launch it today?’ These early computers were 27,000 kg examples yet had about as much power as a calculator today. One invention created the possibility to downsize these huge computer models: the transistor. Developed in the early 1950s the fingertip - sized transistors replaced huge vacuum tubes of the pre-war computers, in helping them to make one decision, between: ‘zero’ or ‘one’, or ‘on’ or ‘off’. That simple decision is the foundation for a code, the language of computers. The transistor opened the door to the personal computer. What about its future? Supercomputers? Computers that are calculating most of the things around us: buildings, airplanes up to the smallest level: our DNA to calculate which gene would have to be targeted for medical improvements. Computers are way ahead of us - or so it seems.

As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don’t have to. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.desc: In this episode of Desperate Hours, we slip the surly bonds of earth to encounter disasters in the air. There have been accidents in the air ever since the time of the Wright brothers and all the improvements in aviation technology since then have lessened but by no means eliminated the dangers of flying. We hope, however, that you are not frantically cancelling your next flight after watching this episode. The chance of getting into or anywhere near a plane crash is actually very low and the air travel is considered one of the safest forms of transport. Many more people die in automobile accidents every year, admittedly with the difference that they don’t usually die hundreds at a time. With that sobering thought, we say farewell, and fly safely

programme.title: Divlja Australija s Rayem Mearsom
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray explores the Red Centre of the country and shows that the Australian desert is filled with life for those who know where to find water.He arrives in the Red Centre by chopper as he flies over the Uluru monolith or Ayres Rock. For his first stop, he goes to a red kangaroo sanctuary where he cuddles a joey, meets their carer Brolga and gets close to the usually wary adult red kangaroos. He pursues his journey deeper in the desert to meet a local aboriginal Sammy Wilson. They go to a traditional waterhole and chat over a camp fire about Sammy’s ancestral knowledge of the land. Ray spends the night out under the stars before driving more inland to rocky areas where water collects. There Ray comes face to face with a wild kangaroo and rock wallabies. He then follows tracks along a dry river bed that lead him to Australia’s wild dog: a dingo.

programme.title: Divlja Australija s Rayem Mearsom
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O’Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird’s that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Životinjska ambasada
programme.desc: Loro Parque, voted World’s Best Zoo two years in a row, blends top-tier animal care with global conservation efforts. From thousands of species to multi-million-dollar research, its mission is clear: protect wildlife and inspire change. What began 45 years ago as one man’s passion is now a global model of excellence in education, sustainability, and animal welfare.

programme.title: Životinjska ambasada
programme.desc: Federica the turtle has arrived from Italy after a run in with a container ship. Loro Parque’s offered to be her ‘forever home’, but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? You’ve heard of a fish out of water - try a turtle! Esmeralda the iguana has a lumpy belly and Jorge the vet is worried. He’s hoping it’s a bounty of eggs but knows he shouldn’t count his iguanas before they hatch. Its fingers crossed for some scaly babies!

programme.title: Moj divlji prijatelj

programme.title: Divljaci
programme.desc: We live in a world full of the most magnificent of animals. There are approximately eight point seven (8.7) million different species on earth. With this vast array of natural wonders how do we choose a favorite amongst all these spectacular creatures? The ethereal grace of the oceans whales, the might of the imposing hippo, the unequalled speed of the cheetah, the mesmerizing lure of the snake, the power of the elephant, the strength of the ant, the stealth of the scorpion, the extraordinary talents of the octopus, the force of the crocodile, the sheer grace of the wedge tailed eagle, or the regular commanding presence of the lion...

programme.title: Divljaci
programme.desc: The mighty grizzly bear. The tiny powerful ant. The lunging inimitable crocodile. The indestructible rhino beetle. The hammering mantis shrimp. Which is the strongest of them all? Grizzly Bear - North America's sub-alpine lands are ruled by its mightiest resident. Ants - With 12,000+ species, ants are fierce, territorial defenders, dispatching intruders with ease. Crocodile - Ancient rulers of rivers, crocodiles have the strongest bite force ever recorded. Rhino Beetle - This forest dweller can lift 850 times its own weight. Mantis Shrimp - With bizarre eyes and a punch as strong as a .22 bullet, it's a tiny powerhouse.

programme.title: Plavo carstvo
programme.desc: There's no doubt sharks have an image problem. And they're certainly in trouble globally. The population of some species has declined by more than 90% due to over fishing. But there's still one place in the world where sharks thrive - the Bahamas. Sharks not only prosper there, they are highly protected. It’s illegal to kill them. Stuart Cove's passion is sharks. Travelling In his private plane, he spreads the gospel of shark advocacy across the Bahamian island chain. And shark tourism is his livelihood. A successful entrepreneur, his main business revolves around scuba diving with sharks. Cove also works with Bahamian and international researchers in their studies of dangerous species such as tiger, hammerhead and bull sharks.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Utrka života
programme.desc: Prey must constantly avoid predators, and any defensive adaptation boosts survival. Speed is a key defense—antelope are built to run, chased by sprinters like cheetahs. Over time, predators evolved to be fast, and prey evolved to be faster. Antelope also travel long distances for food. Ostriches, though flightless, are the fastest-running birds. The Golden Wheel spider escapes danger by turning into a rolling wheel. In the Race of Life, survival depends on clever, sometimes surprising adaptations.

programme.title: Utrka života
programme.desc: Predator vs. prey: this episode explores three bird escape tactics—climbing flight, horizontal speed, and diving. These behaviors reflect the evolutionary arms race. Birds of prey captivate us, from the mighty eagle soaring over open spaces to the peregrine falcon, the fastest animal alive. Vultures, often seen as omens, strip carcasses clean to survive. Whether elegant hunters or grim scavengers, each raptor plays its part in the Race of Life, adapting to stay one step ahead.

programme.title: Na velegradskim krovovima
programme.desc: How is life on the city’s roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures: our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world’s rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Putovanje iz snova
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! - No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people - from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.desc: Jonathan joins an expedition to recruit a new Blue World camera operator in the form of a 1,000 pound Tiger shark! Working with experienced shark handlers, he puts a camera on the dorsal fin of the shark to see what it can film all by itself. But will Jonathan get his camera back? Next, he joins an experienced cave diver to explore a famous underwater cave in Northern Florida (USA).

programme.title: Plavi svijet
programme.desc: Cave diving is the most difficult and dangerous type of diving, so the training to become a certified cave diver is arduous. This episode documents Jonathan’s actual cave training in the Bahamas and follows him as he learns how to dive safely in the overhead environment of a cave in an attempt to earn his full cave diver certification.

programme.title: Šašava znanost
programme.desc: A man with an ear for music, one of the first to try teaching the deaf how to speak, thought he could build a "harmonic telegraph". He had this idea that several notes could travel through a wire simultaneously, instead of the one Morse code that the telegraph could transmit. He thought this to be possible because he misinterpreted the writings of a researcher writing in German - a language he did not know. - And would later describe his misinterpretation as a "very valuable blunder". The man was Alexander Graham Bell and he invented telephony. The big question is: what happens in that wire? How can voices travel? Bell and his assistant eventually proved that different tones would vary the strength of an electric current in a wire. In fact, it’s the vibrations of the voice that determine the strength of the current. His invention caused a lot of fuss - yet it took years before people comprehended the scale of it: before the widespread use of the phone - whom were you going to call? Eventually, the telephone, or better said, its wiring, leads to the Internet. Nowadays we mostly make our calls ‘wireless’ so the wire Graham Bell used to make voices travel over long distances is no longer needed How does that work? Even wireless calling, some say, is actually a very unnatural way of communicating. Looking at the future, are we heading towards a ‘phoneless’ call?

programme.title: Šašava znanost
programme.desc: Plastic has become ubiquitous. Impressive, since we’d been living without them for centuries! We have grown dependent on plastics in many ways. The production industry uses it to connect the parts that make machinery: our trillions of toilet bowls need it, let alone wash machines, computers, toothbrushes, pens and traffic lights. Can you imagine that plastic was accidentally invented for the purpose of making billiard balls? Though, its inventor had used something now called guncotton, which led to a rather explosive game of pool. In the end, the first plastic was discovered when someone witnessed how Southeast Asian farmers used the poop of a little beetle, called shellac, to preserve wood. When looking for a substitute, Leo Beakeland created ‘Bakelite’ and that substance turned out to be the first plastic. Nylon followed, the first man-made synthetic plastic, developed by Dupont to replace silk. Nylon isn’t that difficult to make yourself, amazingly. During WW2 all nylon production went into the manufacturing of parachutes, leading Dupont and others to stop producing pantyhose. It led to true nylon riots. Plastics were plain out popular. Indeed, the age of plastic had only just begun. But plastic is made with oil and is hard to break down, which calls for a solution. A company in the US is creating a bioplastic grown inside microorganisms. In fact - soon they’ll have plants cultivating plastic… plastic grown in the field? Now that is quirky!

programme.title: Oh, to nisam znao!
programme.desc: It’s been sweetening America for almost 40 years! Now, find out the truth behind how SWEET N LOW actually got its name! And why do we yell SHOTGUN when getting into a car with friends? Then, is it really bad luck to open an umbrella in the house? And, learn the salty truth on how the POTATO CHIP was invented out of ANGER!

programme.title: Ukradena remek djela
programme.desc: It’s the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Čudo
programme.desc: The Body Transfer Illusion tricks the brain into feeling ownership of a fake body part, like in the rubber hand experiment. The Autokinetic Effect makes stationary lights seem to move in darkness. The Moon Illusion causes the moon to appear larger near the horizon due to visual references. Geometric illusions distort shapes and lines through clever design. Stereoscopy lets us perceive depth by merging two flat images into one 3D view.

programme.title: Pokaži mi gdje živiš
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don’t have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Dosjei RIP
programme.desc: The team learns to expect the unexpected, as objects move on their own and unexplained sounds plague the investigators.

programme.title: Divlja Australija s Rayem Mearsom
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O’Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird’s that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Divlja Australija s Rayem Mearsom
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He’s there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. When Ray gets too close warns him off.Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.Finally Ray travels with land manager Greg Towns across the dried up mudflats through giant flocks of Magpie Geese. Ray helps Greg to burn away large meadows of alien and destructive grass that is killing the birds. In a dramatic scene Ray witnesses the spectacle of farming with fire.

programme.title: Životinjska ambasada
programme.desc: Rafa, the ‘Birdman of Loro Parque’, proudly leads the Foundation’s ornithological work, surrounded daily by parrots, puffins, and penguins. Meanwhile, Inaki faces a challenge: training Sue-Anne the anteater. Armed with vanilla yoghurt and patience, he’s hoping charm wins over stubbornness. Will she cooperate or snub his efforts?

programme.title: Životinjska ambasada
programme.desc: Ubongo the gorilla has a foot injury, and treating a 400-pound patient takes serious skill. Meanwhile, Ester’s team unveils a coral farm—less cuddly, but just as vital. And in the summer heat, Hugo the sloth cools off with a slow-motion shower. From veterinary challenges to marine innovation and quirky animal moments, Loro Parque never stops surprising.

programme.title: Moj divlji prijatelj
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: Europski otoci
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Divljaci
programme.desc: The explosive sprinting Cheetah. The mighty bounding kangaroo. The horned and leaping wildebeest. The powerful and sure footed horse. Or the quick footed pronghorn. Which is the fastest over land? Cheetah - On Africa’s savannahs, predator and prey race at breathtaking speeds. Pronghorn - North America’s fastest, it sustains 60 km/h and can reach nearly 100. Wildebeest - Iconic endurance runners; calves walk within minutes and run within days. Kangaroo - Australia’s largest marsupial, alert and powerful, built for speed. Brumby - Wild horses, symbols of strength and freedom, gallop unbridled across Australia.

programme.title: Divljaci
programme.desc: Fanged Spiders with their scurrying bites. The Scorpion with its deadly sting... A sinister cold bloodied crocodile. The hypnotizing venomous snake. Or the King of Beasts, the Lion? Which one is the most dangerous? Lion - With golden fur and regal mane, the lion reigns as the ‘King of Beasts’. Scorpions - In scorched deserts, danger awakens after sunset. Spiders - Masters of webs and venom, spiders haunt myth and imagination. Snakes - Feared and revered, snakes symbolize power, death, and rebirth. Crocodile - Ancient and deadly, crocodiles inspire fear and legend across the globe.

programme.title: Plavo carstvo
programme.desc: Believe it or not, many scuba divers want to see great whites up close, and photographers want dramatic shots. But how do you get the sharks to where you want them? For decades, it's been done by baiting, or chumming - attracting sharks with food. This practice is being questioned and banned in many countries because of a dramatic increase in shark attacks.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Sarah Shark

programme.title: Utrka života
programme.desc: Crocodiles, descended from reptiles 250 million years ago, lurk just beneath the waterline, striking fear into prey. Turtles, among the oldest reptiles, use their shells for protection and camouflage across land, freshwater, and sea. Snakes, from rattlesnakes to dwarf pipe snakes, share traits like legless bodies and lidless eyes, relying on sun for warmth. The king cobra’s venom can kill an elephant. Lizards escape predators by shedding tails, which regrow differently. For reptiles, cold blood offers a survival edge in the Race of Life.

programme.title: Utrka života
programme.desc: Predators use speed, teeth, poison, and trickery to survive, but prey animals have evolved fascinating defenses. While fleeing is common, others use deception and chemistry—camouflage, mimicry, and toxins. Insects mimic leaves, snakes play dead, fish fly, and toads have poisonous skin. Predator-prey dynamics form an evolutionary arms race, with each side adapting to outsmart the other. Defense mechanisms include claws, poison, camouflage, and foul sprays. From zebra patterns to spider silk, strong defenses are vital to winning the Race of Life.

programme.title: Na velegradskim krovovima
programme.desc: How is life on the city’s roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures: our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world’s rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Putovanje iz snova
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! - No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people - from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Plavi svijet
programme.desc: Deep in the heart of Mexico’s Yucatan, Jonathan is exploring remote cenotes in the jungle that were once used for Mayan rituals. Just reaching the surface of the water requires rappelling down from the forest above. But then, beneath the surface, he encounters strange alien life forms that live in total darkness, and the remains of humans and animal sacrifices from an ancient culture.

programme.title: Plavi svijet
programme.desc: In the Flower Garden Banks National Marine Sanctuary, Jonathan investigates some of the densest coral reefs in the Caribbean as they spawn under cover of darkness. Then he heads over to Silver Springs for the Sea Hunt Forever Festival, celebrating the classic TV show Sea Hunt and the vintage scuba gear that was used on the program.

programme.title: Šašava znanost
programme.desc: Rubber comes from trees. South American tribes used it long before the world got to know about it. When Columbus witnessed Haitian natives playing ball he found himself mesmerized by the bouncing goo. The South American tribes also made ‘waterproof’ shoes. When Western ships and their sailors brought these back home, the rubber melted on people’s feet. And so did their profits. A stationer accidentally discovered the stuff made a pencil stripe disappear, by rubbing it, and suggested to call it ‘India Rubber’. It took decades for someone to discover how to prevent rubber from melting in heat or stiffening in cold. Charles Goodyear found out how, by dropping a lump of natural rubber on his wife’s stove. By now, chemists know that the vulcanization process links the rubber molecules like pearls on a string, making each piece of rubber one large molecule! Goodyear’s invention spurs the Industrial Revolution. Rubber becomes such a wanted good it instigated a rubber boom - turning Manaus, a remote Brazilian jungle town, into one of the richest cities on earth. This Brazilian monopoly of rubber ended with the theft of 70,000 seeds, by a British traveler named Henry Wickham. It takes decades for someone to discover synthetic rubber. While one researcher was looking for something to replace the rubber in tires - she ended up discovering a material that is so tough it can stop bullets: Kevlar, which also makes a nice vest!

programme.title: Šašava znanost
programme.desc: Who came up with the idea of canned food? It began with a battle between French and British armies, two centuries ago. Napoleon Bonaparte faced many problems with his goal to dominate Europe, one of which was feeding a large and sprawling army. In 1809 Napoleon held a contest, with a prize of 12,000 francs for the person who could come up with the most innovative method of preserving food. The winner was Nicolas François Appert who submitted a method of boiling and sealing food in glass bottles. Well if the French were going to travel farther and farther, the British needed to invent something as well: canning. However, opening the cans was quite a challenge - soldiers worked with stones and bayonets and it was only 30 years later that someone designed the first can opener! Although cans travel much easier across a battlefield, for decades they would not only mysteriously explode, but would also cause the harshest diseases. But how could the scientists of those days know? It wasn't until 50 years after Appert that Louis Pasteur discovered why canning (generally) worked so well. By testing the influence of air on broths, he did away with the idea that things spoiled ‘spontaneously’ and launched his ‘germ theory’. Even though canned foods became safer, they didn’t taste any better. The ultra-lengthy boiling process was obviated with the help of pressure-cooking. And now, the future brings ‘zapped’ canned food, something called ‘raddaperization’. Does the name ring a bell?

programme.title: Nove granice svemira
programme.desc: The Moon, our closest celestial companion. Our indispensible dance partner through the cosmos. Lighting our night sky and gently tugging at our shores. Few have walked on her surface, though her allure remains strong, once again we are glancing her way with renewed interest and with a view to return very soon.

programme.title: Ukradena remek djela
programme.desc: It’s the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Čudo
programme.desc: Iridescence causes surfaces to reflect shifting colors due to light interference. Chemiluminescence produces light via chemical reactions, while bioluminescence does the same in living organisms using luciferin and luciferase. Gemstone colors come from structural elements or impurities affecting light absorption. Mechanical plant defenses include thorns, spines, and microscopic features that help plants survive threats.

programme.title: Čudo
programme.desc: Vear is when visuals trigger imagined sounds, like the silent thud in the jumping pylon illusion. Retinal fatigue causes afterimages after staring at one color too long. The Müller-Lyer illusion tricks us into seeing equal lines as different lengths due to arrowheads. The Ames Room distorts size perception through skewed architecture. Synesthesia links senses—some people see colors when hearing sounds due to hyperconnected neurons.

programme.title: Svakodnevni elementi
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.desc: Nekada davno u čarobnom kraljevstvu New Yorka, gradu koji ne spava, ali puno spava okolo, zemlji najbolje pizze na svijetu i prenapučenim podzemnim željeznicama, dvoje milenijalca Milo i Wendy pronalaze se preko aplikacije za upoznavanje „Cute dating. Nakon veze za jednu noć, čarolija New Yorka ih ponovno spaja te odlučuju postati „najbolji prijatelji s povlasticama kako bi izbjegli zamke veze. Hoće li se prijateljstvo i seks pomiješati bez ikakvih komplikacija? Uz pomoć vratara Colea i njihovih prijatelja Hanka i Jessie koji se također nose s vlastitim komplikacijama nove veze, Milo i Wendy mogli bi pronaći ono što traže.

programme.title: Studentsko tijelo, film
programme.desc: Srednjoškolka Jane Shipley nastoji popraviti svoj narušeni odnos s najboljom prijateljicom iz djetinjstva Merritt i uklopiti se s buntovnim vršnjacima. Kada Janein učitelj matematike prekorači granice, apatičnost uprave srednje škole prisiljava Jane i Merritt da uzmu stvar u svoje ruke, što njihov odnos gura u daljnji preokret i potiče smrtonosne posljedice.

programme.title: Opsjednutost, film
programme.desc: Rebecca Rose (M. Gallagher) socijalna je radnica koja pomaže slijepim ljudima da se nose sa svojom invalidnošću, a dok nije na poslu, bavi se sa svojom psihički nestabilnom sestrom Bedeliom (R. Zal) koja je psihički slom doživjela nakon napastvovanja ujaka Ernieja u djetinjstvu. Bedelia nikad ne izlazi iz kuće, dok Rebecca osim poslovnih nema nikakvih drugih socijalnih kontakata, te su dvije sestre potpuno orijentirane jedna na drugu. No kad se policajcu Jacku Fletcheru (B. Johnson) na zadatku s kolegom Harrisonom Pendragonom (K. Kercheval) dogodi nesreća da izgubi vid, Rebecca je poslana da mu pomogne. Čim ga je spazila, Rebecca se u Jacka strastveno zaljubi te koristi svaku priliku da mu bude blizu, prekoračujući svoje službene ovlasti. Počne potajno promatrati Jacka iako je on ne može vidjeti, tajno napravi ključ njegove kuće i ulazi i izlazi iz nje po volji, dok on to ne zna. Tako i ubije neželjena posjetitelja koji se Jacku došao osvetiti, ali i Jackovu staru ljubav Amy (L. Hardy)... U ovom vrlo solidnom trileru među glumcima treba izdvojiti glavni trio - Megan Gallagher u ulozi psihopatske opsjednute sestre i Roxanu Zal kao također psihički bolesnu drugu sestru. Brad Johnson, prema magazinu "People" 1990. godine bio je izabran među 50 najljepših ljudi na svijetu, a i inače je poznat po svojoj frapantnoj sličnosti sa Tomom Berengerom. Johnson je bio i maneken za reklamu Marlbora i nosio revije Calvina Kleina, a prije nego što se počeo baviti glumom, bio je profesionalni rodeo-kauboj. Od značajnijih naslova u kojima je nastupao svakako treba izdvojiti serijale Melrose Place i Ekipa za očevid: Las Vegas. Redatelj Robert Malenfant potpisnik je serija My Secret Identity (1988), Masked Rider (1995) i Little Men (1998), odnosno filmskih naslova: "The Night Caller" (1998), "The Perfect Nanny" (2000), "Facing the Enemy" (2001).

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću, film
programme.desc: Tko kaže da morate pobijediti, da biste bili prvak? Slava Kolotiloff, učitelj iz uspavanog priobalnog grada po nazivu "Prsti" dolazi osvojiti Moskvu s rukopisom svoje prve novele. Umjesto toga, posve slučajno, osvaja srce prelijepe Nadie (Milla Jovovich). Dok se njihovo vjenčanje približava, Slava treba prekinuti njegov posao i privesti kraju nedovršene poslove u "Prstima" prije povratka u Moskvu, gdje će početi novi život sa svojom mladenkom. Ali uslijed više bizarnih okolnosti, ne može otići, ali se organiziranje vjenčanja ipak nastavlja, a Nadia se mora oduprijeti pažnji bivšeg dečka Danya, koji je spreman učiniti sve što je potrebno, kako bi je ponovo osvojio.

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i rezanci, film
programme.desc: Sredovječni Wang vlasnik je trgovine tjesteninom, već prilično umoran od 10-godišnjeg braka bez djece s privlačnom suprugom. I njegova supruga želi prekinuti takav brak, pa Wanga već neko vrijeme vara s Lijem. Njezino razočaranje brakom je toliko da ona od skupine perzijskih putujućih trgovaca oružjem kupi pištolj. A kad dozna da mu je supruga nevjerna, te da je nabavila i oružje, Wang je odluči ubiti. Za to angažira beskrupuloznog policajca Zhanga...

programme.desc: Nezadovoljna poslom u maloj posredničkoj tvrtki, Sophie daje otkaz i odlazi raditi u poznatu agenciju za osobno i bračno savjetovanje na Manhattnu. Uvijek spremna za nove izazove, bez razmišljanja prihvaća posao savjetnice. No ubrzo se sukobi s glavnim trenerom i zavodnikom Jasonom Sharpeom, koji je ujedno i sin direktora agencija. Jason je šarmantni nevaljalac koji s lakoćom pronalazi put do ljudskih srca. Njih su dvoje prisiljeni raditi zajedno. Hoće li uspjeti sačuvati ugled agencije? Ili će ovaj dvojac neslavno propasti?

programme.title: Majčino svjedočenje, film
programme.desc: Kennyjeva majka, Sharon Carlson (Kate Jackson) i uži krug obitelji i prijatelja nadaju se da se Kenny (Chad Allen) popravio nakon što je proveo dvije godine u zatvoru. Isprva se čini da su Sharonine molitve uslišane i da je Kenny napokon na ispravnom putu. No, nakon što se ponovno sretne sa svojim cimerom iz zatvora Warrenom (Keith Szarabajka) Kennyjevo ponašanje se opet pogorša. Iako se Sharon bojala da će do toga doći, ona ostaje uz svog sina, a nakon što bude upleten u ubojstvo, čini sve kako bi dokazala njegovu nevinost.

programme.title: Opasnost u Rusiji, film
programme.desc: Judd je sredovječni američki odvjetnik koji poslovno dolazi u St. Petersburg, gdje u njegov auto upada atraktivna Ruskinja Saša, tvrdeći da bježi od svodnika. Juddu se mlada žena jako svidi pa joj odluči pomoći. Ispada da je Saša ukrala dragocjenu tijaru kriminalcima koji su je otuđili iz Ermitaža s namjerom da je prodaju izvan Rusije. Patriotski nastrojena Saša to nije željela dopustiti i sad je nevolji. Njezin poočim jedina je osoba kojoj vjeruje, ali uskoro shvati da i u Judda može imati puno povjerenje, štoviše, on joj pruža dragocjenu pomoć, a uskoro se njih dvoje i zaljube...

programme.title: Ljubav i Mary, film
programme.desc: Mary je profinjena slastičarka. Trudi se održati svoju pekaru, ali jednog dana je izbacivanje iz poslovna prostora primorava na zatvaranje posla. Mary sa svojim zaručnikom Brentom odlučuje otputovati k svojoj obitelji u Teksas od koje treba dobiti zaručnički poklon. Na njezinu nesreću Brent dobiva napadaj alergije koja ga sprečava da ide na put. Mary odlučuje sa sobom povesti Brentova identičnog brata blizanca koji je netom izišao iz zatvora i predstaviti ga obitelji kao svojeg zaručnika. Hoće li to biti dobra ideja?

programme.title: Gorko/slatko, film
programme.desc: „Gorko/slatko“ romantična je komedija vođena karakterizacijom likova koje postavlja u neobične, netipične situacije. Film je priča o američkom stručnjaku za kavu Brianu Chandleru (Kip Pardue) koji naizgled ima savršen život. No stvari se počnu mijenjati kada ga njegov šef, odmetnuti magnat i proizvođač kave Calvert Jenkins (James Brolin) pošalje na Tajland na inspekciju usjeva. Pri dolasku Brian upoznaje Tichu (Mamee Nakprasit), bankošku direktoricu koja se brine za glamuroznu, darovitu divu, Tajlanđanku Tatu Young (Tata Young). Budući da je uvijek zaposlena, Ticha je već odavno odustala od potrage za pravom ljubavi. Na nagovor roditelja, uzgajivača kave, Nee i Surapong (Viyada Umarin i Sompop Benjadhikul) koji se nadaju da će Brian kupiti kavu kod njih i spasiti selo od okrutnog posrednika Kanga (Arun Whasadeewong), Ticha pristaje dovesti Briana na plantaže kave u Južni Krabi i pomiriti se sa svojom prošlosti. Zanimljive dodatne zaplete u priči donose i Tichina vatrena sestra Mint (Pakaramai Potranan) i njezin naočit dečko boksač Komane (Akara Amatayakul), njezina pristupačna i otvorena najbolja prijateljica Mook (Kalorin Nemayothin) i njezin urnebesno smiješan dečko Austrijanac Werner (Spencer Garrett), kao i Brianova prelijepa zaručnica Amanda (Laura Sorenson). Brian i Ticha "ista su strana različitih medalja" i zato se neprestano sudaraju. No kad ih putovanje odvede iz velegradske vreve Bangkoka u Krabi, pitoreskni krš okružen plantažama kave, i Biran i Tiha počinju shvaćati da su stvoreni jedno za drugo.

programme.title: Posljednja potjera, film
programme.desc: Godine 1909., Willie Boy i njegova ljubav Carlota kreću u bijeg nakon što on slučajno upuca njenog oca u sukobu koji je krenuo užasno po zlu. S predsjednikom Taftom koji dolazi u područje, lokalni šerif predvodi dva indijanska tragača koji traže pravdu za svog „ubijenog" plemenskog vođu.

programme.title: Nestala, film
programme.desc: Jill (Amanda Seyfried) se vraća kući nakon noćne smjene i otkriva da je njena sestra Molly oteta. Prije godinu dana Jill je uspjela pobjeći otmičaru i uvjerena je da se isti serijski ubojica vratio po Molly. Pošto ubojica nije ostavio nikakav trag, policija nema dokaza i ne može joj pomoći. Strahujući da će Molly biti mrtva prije jutra, Jill kreće u samostalnu potjeru kako bi se suočila s ubojicom.Da li će imati dovoljno vremena da ga nadmudri, otkrije njegove tajne i spasi sestru?

programme.title: Na prvi pogled, film
programme.desc: Timu Gatesu (J. Wilder) javlja se nakon dugog vremena nekad blizak prijatelj Barry Rengler (S. Baio). Barry živi u Saint Louisu, namjerava doputovati u Los Angeles i usput bi posjetio Tima. Tim je isprva iznenađen, ali se ipak veseli susretu sa starim prijateljem. Barry će biti još više iznenađen kad vidi kako Tim živi na visokoj nozi, ima luksuzan automobil, veliku, lijepo namještenu kuću. Posao kojim se bavi očito je unosan, ali mu Tim ne želi otkriti detalje, samo kaže da se radi o ulaganju tuđeg novca, za koje dobiva izdašan postotak. Već prvu večer Barry upozna Timovu djevojku Cyd (K. Allen), otkriva da je Tim suvlasnik kluba u koji su otišli na piće, gdje im se pridruži nametljiva, ali privlačnu Cat (S. Hess). Za Barryja je Timov svijet nov i nepoznat, ali mu nije mrsko uživati u luksuzu. Gotovo da poprima Timov identitet, jer mu je već prve večeri nestao novčanik sa svim dokumentima, karticama i novcima... Krimić "Face Value" vrlo je zanimljiv, ima nepredvidive obrate i uvjerljivog glavnog glumca, Scotta Baia. Režirao ga je iskusni televizijski redatelj Michael Miller.

programme.title: Ljubavni brodolom, film
programme.desc: Jenny Taylor (Amanda Bynes) našla je svojeg idealnog muškarca za kojeg je sigurna da će je potpuno osvojiti. No, postoji jedan problem. Njen idealan muškarac je Jason Masters (Chris Carmack), najveća rock-zvijezda na svijetu. Nadajući se da će dobiti priliku i približiti se svojem idolu, Jenny se zapošljava u njegovom omiljenom karipskom odmaralištu, St. Luchasu, zajedno s Ryanom (Jonathan Bennett). Dok joj Ryan pomaže dajući joj savjete od kojih će joj pomoći da preživi na otoku, Ryanov prijatelj mu daje savjete kako se udvarati Jenny. Ryan se potpuno promijeni, no kada ga Jenny vidi, govori samo o Jasonu. Ryan se loše osjeća i odluči otići, no zaustavi auto nasred puta, iziđe i poljubi je. Kaže joj da su stvoreni jedno za drugo, no Jenny mu kaže da su samo prijatelji. Kada to čuje, grozno se osjeća te nju ostavi na cesti, a on uđe u auto i kaže da se vraća kući. Jenny postane žao te se odluči ispričati. Ona je još na drugoj strani otoka kada se Ryan počne spremati za povratak kući. U tom se trenutku pročuje vijest da će snažna oluja pogoditi St. Luchas. Jenny ne zna što se sprema, a Ryan se požuri kako bi je spasio. Kada Jason za vrijeme oluje završi u moru, Jenny skoči za njim kako bi ga spasila te se oboje nađu na naoko pustom tropskom otoku. Jenny shvati da su samo nekoliko kilometara udaljeni od odmarališta, no umjesto da Jasonu kaže istinu, ona ga ostavi u uvjerenju da su se nasukali kako bi ga natjerala da se zaljubi u nju. Kada otkrije njezin plan, Jennyna se suparnica Alexis (Jamie-Lynn Discala) odluči pretvarati da se i ona nasukala. Jennyn se plan počne raspadati te shvati da joj je savršena ljubav cijelo vrijeme pred nosom.

programme.title: Božićni izazov, TV film
programme.desc: Voditeljica podcasta Laura Ross i njen dugogodišnji prijatelj i producent Paul izazvani su da preispitaju svoje osobne i profesionalne odnose, kad slušatelj predloži dnevni "Božićni izazov", koji promiče zajedništvo, njihovom ambicioznom podcastu "Moderno neovisni".

programme.title: Tomiris, film
programme.desc: Priča o najvećoj kraljici stepe: legendarnoj Tomiridi. Postat će vješta ratnica, preživjet će gubitak bliskih osoba te ujediniti plemena Skita...

programme.title: Satin, film
programme.desc: Pjevač Jack Satin bez novca je i bez posla, ali opsjednut je težnjom za slavom. Kada je prisiljen napustiti Las Vegas, spakira stvari u stari Cadillac i zaputi se prema Atlantic Cityju. Ubrzo mu se pokvari auto zbog čega zapne u gradiću Lost Springsu. Ondje upozna džez-legendu Doca Bishopa koji mu pomogne u nevolji s automobilom. Iako je daleko od svjetla pozornice, Jack se počinje osjećati kao kod kuće u malom gradiću. Nakon što upozna zgodnu konobaricu Lauren Wells, Jack uvidi da je život mnogo više od slave i bogatstva.

programme.title: Ljubav na prvi like, TV film
programme.desc: Cinična novinarka piše članak o Don Juanu nove generacije te otkrije da kod njega postoji više od onoga što se vidi na prvi pogled.

programme.title: Opening night, film
programme.desc: Ovaj se film u potpunosti odvija tijekom premijere srednjoškolskog uprizorenja Shakespearovog "Sna Ivanjske noći." Ovo su kronike s pozornice i iza kulisa koje bilježe tragedije i dramu grupe srednjoškolaca, njihovog učitelja i zvijezde malih ekrana.

programme.title: Pisac iz sjene, film
programme.desc: On je pisac iz sjene (E. McGregor) i za pozamašnu svotu treba urediti memoare Adama Langa (P. Brosnan), bivšeg britanskog premijera, čiji je dotadašnji stalni suradnik smrtno stradao. Nakon dugogodišnjeg sudjelovanja u politici Lang je otišao u mirovinu i preselio se sa ženom i osobljem u Ameriku gdje živi izolirano i piše. Novi pisac ubrzo je uvučen u političke i seksualne intrige s Langovom ženom Ruth (O. Williams) i njezinom pomoćnicom (K. Kattrall), a Langu su počele opasno prijetiti tajne iz prošlosti... Film je snimljen prema romanu "The Ghost" Roberta Harrisa koji je zajedno s redateljem Polanskim napisao scenarij. Film je dobio mnogobrojne nagrade, osobito Polanski za režiju (Berlin) te glumci E. McGregor za glavnu ulogu bezimenog pisca i Olivia Williams za ulogu Langove žene. Većina kritičara se slaže da je Polanski vješto pretočio roman u napeti politički triler.

programme.title: Ljubavnica, serija
programme.desc: Kada Dong-seoka uhite zbog ubojstva, Jung-won odlučuje vjerovati mu unatoč kaosu. Se-yeon se nađe na meti socijalnih službi i policije kao glavna osumnjičenica u slučaju prijevare u osiguranju. Uz Sang-hoonovu pomoć, skriva se i postavlja posljednju, opasnu zamku kako bi namamila svog supruga, Young-daea. Da bi očistila svoje ime, mora otkriti tajne koje se borila sakriti.

programme.title: Ljubavnica, serija
programme.desc: Young-dae službeno otkriva da je živ - ne da bi se vratio kući, nego da bi optužio Se-yeon za sve svoje zločine. Dok se dokazi gomilaju protiv nje, Se-yeon i njene prijateljice očajnički traže Sang-hoona, jedinog svjedoka Young-daeovih zločina. Se-yeon ulaže posljednji pokušaj da uvjeri dadilju Jung-shim. Koji je konačni napredak protiv čudovišta s dva lica?

programme.title: Spremnik, film
programme.desc: Nakon što su misteriozno naslijedili napušteno obalno imanje, Ben i njegova obitelj slučajno oslobađaju drevno, dugo uspavano stvorenje koje je teroriziralo cijelu regiju - uključujući i Benove pretke - generacijama.

programme.title: Ukleta kuća, film
programme.desc: Kada se nakon majčine smrti s ocem preseli u New Orleans, Kelly (Elisabeth Moss) otkriva da se u novoj kući počinju događati čudne stvari. Uvjerena da je u kući duh koji treba njezinu pomoć, povjeri se ocu. No on joj ne vjeruje pa ona pokuša otkriti istinu uz pomoć prijatelja Colea (Austin O'Brien).

programme.title: Guido Superstar: Guidov uspon, film
programme.desc: Talijanski imigrant se ubacuje u svijet trgovaca drogom, super auta i tajnih agenata u ovoj urnebesnoj akcijskoj komediji. Nakon što je izgubio posao u 'Disco Valet Company' zbog pretjeranog junaštva, Guido (Silvio Pollio) mora izigravati sicilijanskog gangstera za FBI, kako bi se ubacio u moćnu azijsku bandu. Stvari postanu neugodne i postanu još gore. Guido se sada mora iskupiti prije nego što bude razotkriven i ubijen, ili još gore, deportiran.

programme.title: Banda iz Sugar Creeka: Nevolje s učiteljem, film
programme.desc: Dječja banda iz Sugar Creeka samo je banda po imenu, a inače je to skupina dobre, iako nestašne djece. Među njima je i mali Tom, čiji je stariji brat Bob nepopravljivo zao i nije dio njihove skupine. Budući da po prirodi radi nevolje, Bob će bandi Suger Creek podmetnuti nekoliko opasnih nedjela, a najgore što će učiniti bit će trovanje lijepog konja koji pripada novom učitelju, g. Blacku. Konj će, srećom, preživjeti, a g. Black kaznit će nevinu bandu. A oni, iako pretpostavljaju tko je počinitelj, ništa ne otkrivaju dok ne nađu dokaze. Ni Bob ne miruje. Osim krađe golubova, zamalo će prouzročiti i požar i donijeti mnoge nevolje...

programme.title: Rezultat: Mjuzikl na ledu, film
programme.desc: 17-godišnji Farley je vodio zaštićeni život, odrastao na dijeti školovanja kod kuće, organskog života i odlazaka u umjetničku galeriju. Na užas svojih roditelja, Farley voli igrati hokej s lokalnom djecom. Na njihovu još veću nesreću, Farleyja je zapazio i angažirao vlasnik juniorske lige, gdje on odmah postaje zvijezda. Ali Farley otkriva da slava zvijezda ima svoju cijenu - uključujući i očekivanje borbe na ledu. Dodajte tome odnos s najboljim prijateljem i Farley se nađe u situaciji kad se počne gubiti.

programme.title: Rezultat: Mjuzikl na ledu, film

programme.title: Djeca bez granica, film
programme.desc: Ashton, Celeste i Becca su tri nevjerojatna izopćenika iz srednje škole koji formiraju klub u napuštenom kazalištu. Tamo upoznaju Charlieja (Bill Cobbs, Noć u muzeju), beskućnika koji dijeli njihovu strast prema glazbenom kazalištu. Kad je predviđeno rušenje kazališta, tinejdžeri ga odluče spasiti modernom izvedbom Shakespeareove 'Puno buke ni oko čega'. Usput, grupa uči odnositi se prema drugima s poštovanjem i braniti svoja uvjerenja. Kanal Dove je odobrio ovaj film, u kojem nastupa i Lee Meriwether, nominiran za Emmy i Zlatni globus.

programme.title: Ukradena priča, film
programme.desc: Kad Rory Jansen (Bradley Cooper) objavi svoj prvi roman, to je onaj rijedak, jedinstveni događaj što literarni svijet i javnost obori s nogu. Prijatelji ga zdušno preporučuju, kritika diže u nebesa i jednostavno je posvuda; od književnih klubova, aviona do sveučilišnih kampusa. Svježinom glasa i mudrošću koja se čini nekako bezvremenskom, Rory postaje instant zvijezda na literarnom nebu. Karizmatičan, talentiran, inteligentan, čini se da mladi autor ima sve: divan život, krasnu suprugu (Zoë Saldana), svijet mu je pod nogama- i sve to zbog njegovih riječi. Ali čije su to riječi? I na koncu, čija je priča? Na vrhuncu slave, tajanstveni starac (Jeremy Irons) dođe Roryju i suoči ga s činjenicom da je zapravo on autor romana. Starac prebrojava prelijepe, ali tragične uspomene iz svoje mladosti u Parizu nakon II. Svjetskog rata, na temelju kojih je roman i nastao. Vidjevši da je netko drugi platio cijenu za istinu i viziju priča, Rory preispituje svoju kreativnost, ambiciju i moralni izbor koji je učinio na milost i nemilost ovih poriva. Napisana kao priča u priči i Roryjev život je proizvod mašte. Iza svega stoji stvarni literarni mag, Clay Hammond (Dennis Quaid.) Prekrasna i lukava studentica (Olivia Wilde) navela ga je na priču o stvarnom značenju njegova romana,pri čemu si ne može pomoći sakriti vezu između priče i vlastite tajnovite prošlosti.

programme.title: Terminator: Spasenje, film
programme.desc: Smješten u postapokaliptičnu 2018. godinu, John Connor je čovjek predodređen da vodi ljudski pokret otpora protiv Skyneta i njegove vojske Terminatora. No, budućnost u koju Connor vjeruje je promijenjena dolaskom Marcusa Wrighta, stranca čije je posljednje sjećanje kako stoji u redu za strijeljanje. Connor mora odlučiti da li je Marcus poslan iz budućnosti, ili je spašen iz prošlosti. Dok se Skynet priprema za konačni napad, njih dvojica kreću u potragu koja ih dovodi do centra Skynetovih operacija, gdje otkrivaju užasnu tajnu koja se krije iza mogućeg uništenja ljudskog roda...

programme.title: Terminator: Spasenje, film
programme.desc: Smješten u postapokaliptičnu 2018. godinu, John Connor je čovjek predodređen da vodi ljudski pokret otpora protiv Skyneta i njegove vojske Terminatora. No, budućnost u koju Connor vjeruje je promijenjena dolaskom Marcusa Wrighta, stranca čije je posljednje sjećanje kako stoji u redu za strijeljanje. Connor mora odlučiti da li je Marcus poslan iz budućnosti, ili je spašen iz prošlosti. Dok se Skynet priprema za konačni napad, njih dvojica kreću u potragu koja ih dovodi do centra Skynetovih operacija, gdje otkrivaju užasnu tajnu koja se krije iza mogućeg uništenja ljudskog roda...

programme.title: Postanak, film
programme.desc: Britanski prirodoslovac i obrazovanjem teolog Charles Darwin (P. Bettany) mnogo je godina proveo promišljajući i razvijajući svoju teoriju o vrstama i njihovu porijeklu, te sad sa suprugom Emmom (J. Connely) čeka konačno objavljivanje svoje kapitalne knjige "Porijeklo vrsta". Uživanje u uspjehu i čestitkama Charlesu i Emmi poremetit će smrt njihove 10-godišnje kćeri Annie (M. West). Pod utjecajem obiteljske tragedije ali i posljedica do kojih će dovesti objavljivanje knjige, odnos Charlesa i Emme će se početi mijenjati. S jedne strane, ideja o "ubijanju Boga" Charlesu se nimalo ne sviđa jer dobro zna koliko je religija važna za izgradnju civiliziranog i moralnog društva, te se boji da bi se ljudi pod utjecajem njegove knjige mogli početi odricati Boga. S druge strane, Emma je velika vjernica ali i izuzetno obrazovana žena koja zna da se znanost često kosi s njezinim uvjerenjima. Charles će se tako naći rastrgan tugom za preminulom kćeri, zategnutim odnosima s Emmom te žestokim napadima nekih kolega, ali i konzervativnog svećenika Innesa (J. Northam)...

programme.title: Tata od formata, film
programme.desc: "Tata od formata" prikazuje manje eksponiranu stranu Adama Sandlera. Dok su njegovi rani nastupi pamćeni kao grubi, drski i bizarni, u ovoj sjajnoj obiteljskoj komediji o neobičnom posvajanju iznimno talentirani Sandler ima priliku pokazati i nježnije, brižnije lice. Sonny Koufax (Adam Sandler) je tridesetogodišnjak s manjkom ambicija i viškom slobodnog vremena. Njegova djevojka Vanessa (Kristy Swanson) čvrsto je naumila raskinuti vezu, a njegov cimer, Kevin (Jon Stewart), otputovao je u inozemstvo bez naznaka skorog povratka. Kada se na Sonnyjevim vratima pojavi šestogodišnji Julian (Cole/Dylan Sprouse), Sonny u njemu vidi nadu za iskupljenje - pokazat će djevojci da može biti odgovorna osoba. Naravno, biti otac nestašnom šestogodišnjaku, daleko je od jednostavna zadatka...Slično pokušajima Jima Carreyja da se afirmira izvan matičnog žanra komedije, tako je i Adam Sandler u "Tati od formata" pokušao ostaviti ponešto drugačiji dojam od tipičnih provokatorskih uloga. Sandlerova genijalnost vidljiva je u svakom trenutku ove odlične komedije koja na domišljat način spaja humor i melodramu. Humor u filmu prilagođen je svim uzrastima, iako će posebno oduševiti najmlađe, ali i ponekog "neozbiljnog" roditelja. Film je režirao renomirani Dennis Dugan, filmaš s mnogo kvalitetnih serija u rezimeu, a posebno treba istaknuti "Ally McBeal" i "Chicago Hope". U manjoj ulozi pojavljuje se legendarni Steve Buscemi ("Fargo"), a Sandlerovu djevojku glumi lijepa Kristy Swanson ("Buffy").

programme.title: Sjevernjak, film
programme.desc: Princu Amlethu dok je još bio dječak, stric okrutno ubije oca i otme majku. Dva desetljeća poslije, Amleth, sada Viking, odluči spasiti svoju majku te ubiti strica i osvetiti oca...

programme.title: Sjevernjak, film
programme.desc: Princu Amlethu dok je još bio dječak, stric okrutno ubije oca i otme majku. Dva desetljeća poslije, Amleth, sada Viking, odluči spasiti svoju majku te ubiti strica i osvetiti oca...

programme.title: Rušenje, film
programme.desc: U filmu RUŠENJE uspješni investicijski bankar, Davis Mitchell (Jake Gyllenhaal), prolazi kroz teško razdoblje nakon što je izgubio suprugu u tragičnoj prometnoj nesreći. Unatoč tomu što ga tast Phil (Chris Cooper) tjera da se sabere, Davis se nastavlja raspadati. Ono što započne kao pismo pritužbe tvrtki koja proizvodi prodajne automate pretvori se u seriju pisama koja otkrivaju iznenađujuća osobna priznanja. Davisova pisma privuku pozornost agentice službe za korisnike Karen Mareno (Naomi Watts) te se, usred njezinih vlastitih emocionalnih i financijskih tereta, dvoje stranaca poveže na nevjerojatan način. Uz pomoć Karen i njezina sina (Judah Lewis) Davis se počne osovljavati na noge, počevši s uništavanjem života koji je nekad poznavao.

programme.title: U raljama zvijeri, film
programme.desc: Jake Hopper bio je prije deset godina agent CIA-e stacioniran u Tajlandu. Sada vodi vlastitu osiguravateljsku kompaniju u SAD-u, no netko je oteo njegovu kćer Jessicu dok je s prijateljicom, kćeri američkog senatora, turistički boravila u Tajlandu. Otmicu su navodno izveli islamski fundamentalisti pa američka vlada šalje svoje ljude u Tajland da oslobode djevojke. Jake također odlazi u Tajland i tamo uz pomoć starog prijatelja Suntija, sad budističkog svećenika, pokušava ući u trag otmičarima te spasiti kćer i njezinu prijateljicu. Jake pomaže i mlada i dražesna Lulu te otkrije da otmičari nisu islamisti nego odmetnuti general Jantapan... Nekadašnja velika zvijezda akcijskog žanra Steve Seagal (Iznad zakona, Pod opsadom 1 i 2) više nije u središtu pozornosti, ali njegovi filmovi još itekako privlače pozornost ljubitelja akcijskih filmova. "Belly of the Beast" snimio je prema vlasitoj priči u Hong Kongu, u režiji produktivnog Siu-Tung Chinga, dobro poznatog hongkonškog sineasta, posebno istaknutog kao koreografa akcijskih prizora, koji je surađivao i s takvim velikanima kao što su Hark Tsui i Zhimou Yang. "Belly of the Beast" svakako će zadovoljiti poklonike akcijsko-borilačkog filma, jer riječ je kompaktnom, izvrsno produciranom i napetom ostvarenju zanimljive priče i pouzdanih glumačkih izvedbi.

programme.title: Mučno, film
programme.desc: Suparništvo između dva brata se pretvara u izdaju. Jedan je pristalica (Gary Stretch) uspješnog, ali pomalo sumnjivog biznismena (Stephen Rea), a drugi glavni kandidat za premijera (Adrian Paul). Uz priliku dugo priželjkivane osvete protiv otuđene obitelji (Christopher Lee, Jean Marsh), dok ga proganja psihotični policijski detektiv (Vinnie Jones), naš neprilagođeni anti junak mora otkriti istinu u svijetu, u kojem nikome ne možeš vjerovati, a odanost predstavlja rijetkost.

programme.title: Bitka za Saipan, film
programme.desc: Kad bolnicu američke vojske na udaljenom otoku Saipan preplave japanske snage, usamljeni bolničar stavlja sve na kocku, kako bi skupinu ranjenih ratnika odveo na sigurno u ovoj napetoj epopeji iz Drugog svjetskog rata.

programme.title: Čarobnjak i bijela zmija, film
programme.desc: Redatelj ove priče je Ching Siu-Tung. Svoj film temelji na staroj kineskoj legendi o uzgajivaču ljekovitog bilja koji se zaljubljuje u bijelu zmiju staru tisuću godina, skrivenu u liku žene. Jet Li glumi čarobnjaka koji otkriva pravi identitet zmije i počinje borbu za dušu ovog čovjeka.

programme.title: Postolar, film
programme.desc: Max Simkin popravlja cipele u trgovini u New Yorku koja je u vlasništvu njegove obitelji veće nekoliko generacija. Nezadovoljan svojim životom, Max slučajno naiđe na magičnu dragocjenost koja mu omogući da vidi svijet iz perspektive svojih klijenata.

programme.title: Izgubljeno blago Jesseja Jamesa, film
programme.desc: Grupa djece iz zaleđa Missourija utrkuje se kako bi riješili sto godina staru tajnu i spasili svoje prijatelje u ovoj obiteljskoj akcijskoj avanturi. Proganjani duboko u drevne špilje, moraju pobjeći tragačima za blagom koji su im za petama ili će biti zauvijek izgubljeni.

programme.title: Charliejevi anđeli, film
programme.desc: Natalie (Cameron Diaz), Dylan (Drew Barrymore) i Alex (Lucy Liu), znane i kao "Charliejevi anđeli", pripadnice su neobične detektivske agencije. Njihova nova zadaća pronalazak je elektronskog genija Knoxa (Sam Rockwell), čiji je nestanak prijavila njegova najbolja prijateljica Vivian (Kelly Lynch). Najsumnjiviji je Knoxov glavni rival, magnat Corwin (Tim Curry), ali anđeli se moraju obračunati i s poremećenim ubojicom koji im stoji na putu...

programme.title: Priča o Jane Austen, film
programme.desc: Biografska romantična drama o Jane Austen i mladom Ircu prije nego što je postala slavna spisateljica. Jane je mlađa kći svećenika Georga Austena i obitelj traži odgovarajućeg muškarca za njezina muža. Ona je više zainteresirana za pisanje nego za udaju što izaziva majčino zgražanje, ali i očev ponos. Jedan od mogućih kandidata je Thomas Lefroy, advokat pred kojim je karijera... Film se djelomično temelji na knjizi Jona Huntera Specea "Becoming Jane Austen", koji je bio i konzultant za povijest.
